Institutions and organizations increasingly require efficient systems to manage courses, students, and learning resources. This project presents the development of an AI Learning and Course Management Platform, a web-based system designed to integrate academic learning, online courses, and business training within a unified environment.</p><p><br />The proposed system addresses key challenges in existing manual and semi-digital systems, such as inefficient course management, difficulty in tracking student performance, lack of centralized resources, and absence of intelligent decision-making support. The platform provides features including course management, student enrollment, webinar management, resource sharing, and performance tracking.</p><p>A major contribution of this system is the integration of Artificial Intelligence to enhance learning outcomes. AI modules provide personalized course recommendations based on student behavior, performance analysis through data-driven insights, automated webinar summaries, and an intelligent learning assistant to guide students.</p><p>The system is developed using modern web technologies such as SvelteKit for frontend and backend integration, PostgreSQL/SQLite for database management, and AI APIs for intelligent features. The platform supports multiple user roles including Admin, Instructor, Student, and Business Manager, each with defined access control.</p><p>The proposed solution improves learning efficiency, enhances engagement, and provides scalable infrastructure for both educational institutions and corporate training environments. This project demonstrates how AI-driven systems can revolutionize learning management by combining automation, analytics, and user-centric design.</p><h3>List of Figures<br Results</p></td><td></td></tr></table><p><img src="data:image/png;base64," /></p><h2>CHAPTER 1 – INTRODUCTION TO INTERNSHIP PROJECT</h2><h4>Project - Internship Summary</h4><p>The project titled “<strong>AI Learning and Course Management Platform</strong>” is a web-based application designed to manage and enhance digital learning environments. The system integrates course management, student enrollment, webinar handling, resource sharing, and AI-driven features into a unified platform.<br /></p><p>The primary goal of the system is to simplify learning management while improving user experience through intelligent automation and data-driven insights. The platform supports multiple user roles including Admin, Instructor, Student, and Business Manager.</p><h6>Purpose</h6><p>The purpose of this project is to develop a centralized and intelligent system that addresses the limitations of traditional and existing digital learning platforms. The system aims to improve efficiency in managing educational content and provide enhanced learning support using AI technologies.<br /></p><p><strong>1.3</strong> <strong>Objectives</strong></p><ul><li>To design a scalable web-based learning management system</li><li>To enable efficient course and user management</li><li>To provide online learning support through webinars</li><li>To integrate AI features such as recommendations and performance analysis</li><li>To improve user engagement and learning outcomes</li></ul><p><strong>1.4 Scope</strong></p><p>The system is intended for educational institutions, training organizations, and businesses. It allows users to create, manage, and access learning content efficiently.</p><p><strong>Scope Includes:</strong></p><p>•	Course creation and management</p><p>•	Student enrollment and tracking</p><p>•	Webinar scheduling and participation</p><p>•	Resource management (documents, videos, etc.)</p><p>•	AI-based recommendations and analytics</p><p><strong>Limitations:</strong></p><p>•	Requires internet connectivity</p><p>•	AI accuracy depends on available data</p><p>•	Limited third-party integrations in current version</p><p><strong>	1.5 Technology</strong></p><p>The system is developed using modern technologies to ensure scalability and performance:</p><ul><li><strong>Frontend &amp; Backend</strong>: SvelteKit</li><li><strong>Database</strong>: PostgreSQL / SQLite</li><li><strong>Authentication</strong>: Role-based access system</li><li><strong>AI Integration</strong>: External AI APIs</li></ul><p>Existing systems such as traditional LMS platforms provide basic functionalities but lack advanced AI-driven features. This project builds upon those systems by incorporating intelligent automation and analytics.</p><ul><li><ol><li><strong>Project Planning</strong></li></ol></li></ul><p><strong>1.6.1 Development Approach and Justification</strong></p><p>The project follows an <strong>Agile development approach</strong>, allowing iterative development, continuous testing, and flexibility in incorporating new features. This approach is suitable due to the evolving nature of requirements and integration of AI components.</p><p><strong>1.6.2 Effort, Time, and Cost Estimation</strong></p><p>The project development is divided into phases including requirement analysis, design, development, testing, and deployment.</p><ul><li>Requirement Analysis: 1–2 weeks</li><li>System Design: 2 weeks</li><li>Development: 4–6 weeks</li><li>Testing &amp; Debugging: 2 weeks</li></ul><p>Cost is minimized as the system uses open-source technologies and APIs.</p><p><strong>1.6.3 Roles and Responsibilities</strong></p><ul><li><strong>Developer:</strong> System design, coding, and implementation</li><li><strong>Designer:</strong> UI/UX design and user experience optimization</li><li><strong>Tester:</strong> Testing functionality and identifying bugs</li><li><strong>Project Lead:</strong> Planning, coordination, and decision-making</li></ul><p><strong>1.6.4 Dependencies</strong></p><ul><li>Internet connectivity</li><li>Availability of AI APIs</li><li>System compatibility with browsers and devices</li></ul><p><strong>1.7 Project Scheduling</strong></p><p>The project follows a structured timeline where each phase is completed sequentially with some overlap in development and testing phases. Agile sprints are used to track progress and ensure timely completion of tasks.</p><h2>CHAPTER 2 – SYSTEM ANALYSIS</h2><h4>Study of Current System</h4><p>The current learning and course management systems used by many institutions are either manual or partially digital. The platform is stable, secure, and ready for deployment with scope for future improvements. </p><h2>CHAPTER 6 – CONCLUSION AND DISCUSSION<br /></h2><p><strong>6.1 Overall Analysis of Project Viability<br /></strong></p><p>The AI Learning and Course Management Platform proves to be a viable and effective solution for modern digital learning environments. The system successfully integrates course management, student tracking, resource handling, and AI-driven features into a unified platform.</p><p>From a technical perspective, the use of modern web technologies ensures scalability, performance, and maintainability. Economically, the system is cost-effective due to the use of open-source tools. Operationally, the platform is user-friendly and can be adopted by educational institutions and organizations with minimal training.</p><p><strong><br />6.2 Problem Encountered and Solutions</strong></p><p>During the development of the system, several challenges were encountered:</p><p>•	Integration of AI APIs:</p><p>Difficulty in handling responses and ensuring relevant outputs</p><p>Solution: Implemented structured data handling and filtering mechanisms</p><p>•	Data Management Complexity:</p><p>Managing relationships between multiple entities</p><p>Solution: Designed normalized database schema with proper relationships</p><p>•	User Role Management:</p><p>Ensuring secure and accurate access control</p><p>Solution: Implemented role-based authentication and authorization</p><p>•	Performance Optimization:</p><p>Handling multiple requests efficiently</p><p>Solution: Optimized database queries and modularized backend logic</p><p><strong><br />6.3 Summary of Project Work</strong></p><p>The project involved the complete development lifecycle including requirement analysis, system design, implementation, and testing. The platform supports multiple user roles and provides functionalities such as course creation, enrollment, webinar management, resource sharing, and performance tracking.</p><p>The integration of AI enhances the system by providing personalized recommendations, intelligent assistance, and performance insights.</p><p><strong>6.4 Limitations</strong></p><p>Despite its advantages, the system has certain limitations:</p><p>•	Dependence on internet connectivity</p><p>•	AI accuracy depends on available data</p><p>•	Limited advanced analytics in current version</p><p>•	Limited integration with external platforms</p><p><strong><br /><br />6.5 Future Enhancements</strong></p><p>The system can be further improved by:</p><p>•	Developing a mobile application</p><p>•	Implementing advanced AI-based personalized learning paths</p><p>•	Enhancing analytics and reporting features</p><p>•	Integrating with third-party platforms (e.g., payment systems, external LMS)</p><p>•	Improving scalability for large-scale deployment</p><p><strong><br />6.6 Final Conclusion</strong></p><p>The developed system demonstrates how modern technologies and artificial intelligence can be combined to create an efficient and intelligent learning management platform. It improves both administrative processes and learning experiences, making it a valuable solution for educational institutions and organizations.</p><p>The project highlights the importance of integrating automation, data analysis, and user-centric design in building future-ready systems.</p><p><strong>APPENDIX</strong></p><p><strong>Appendix A: Sample Screens (UI Representation)<br /></strong></p><p>The system includes multiple user interfaces for different roles:</p><ul><li>Admin Dashboard (User &amp;
